commentary_segments.text: Now that we know the principles of shunt-shunt feedback, let us learn about the other type of feedback with shunt feedback at the input. It also takes input currents. It has series feedback at the output. It acts as a current generator. It is therefore a current amplifier with gain A . It amplifies the I input current to the output with high precision. Its input resistance will be low and its output resistance high.
